Best Brake Bleeders

Three ways to get old fluid and trapped air out of a brake line: a check valve bottle you run with the pedal, a vacuum pump that pulls fluid at the caliper, and a pressure tank that pushes it down from the reservoir. Each one puts the pressure in a different place, and that is the whole difference. From a $22 bottle to a $389 shop system.
